description: data.london.gov.uk: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.london.gov.uk. Coverage: the area served by data.london.gov.uk. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Baseline and post-scheme implementation traffic counts for London Boro; 5 Kingdom Street application documents; 7 Brannan Street Hearing Documents; 134 Kenton Road hearing documents. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
